likelihood.decision_tolerance: no real score until payload hashes, schema receipts, exact frequency-dependent calibration artifacts, and the frozen injection suite pass are sealed
likelihood.formula: log L_profile(K,t0,delta_LH)=-0.5 sum_d 4*delta_f*sum_{20<=f<=512}|d_d(f)-c_d_hat exp(-2*pi*i*f*(t0+delta_d)) q_K(f)|^2/S_d(f), where c_d_hat is the analytic complex weighted-least-squares coefficient
likelihood.kernel_scale: T_star=0.01 s and all dimensionless kernel parameters inherited unchanged from v1; no per-event tuning
likelihood.kind: exactly frozen profiled relative frequency-domain Whittle Gaussian

nuisance_grid.complex_amplitude: one analytic weighted-least-squares coefficient c_d per detector; absorbs constant antenna/calibration amplitude and phase only

likelihood.optimizer: exhaustive declared t0 x delta_LH grid; analytic c_d; no stochastic sampler and no post-response grid change
likelihood.template: place the v1 4096 Hz normalized SXS:BBH:0305 source at t=0 in an 8 s zero-padded array, execute the unchanged driver/kernel law, FFT after the same Tukey window, and never use strain to choose driver or kernel parameters

validation_suite.required_before_response_scoring: zero false early-response detections; >=90% correct equivalence-family recovery at SNR 20; report all failures

missing: exact frequency-dependent calibration response artifacts and hashes

preprocessing.analysis_window: Tukey alpha=0.125 on the 8 s analysis interval
preprocessing.detrend: subtract mean then scipy.signal.detrend type=linear separately by detector and interval
preprocessing.dq_rule: require every analysis sample to pass the frozen simple DQ mask; otherwise reject event
preprocessing.fft: real FFT with delta_f=0.125 Hz for the 8 s analysis interval
preprocessing.psd: Welch Hann 4 s segments, 50% overlap, median average within each off-source interval, arithmetic mean of the two interval PSDs
